summary: FD_TC_066_No Travel Incomplete, Uncontrollable (arrival delay code 82, ATFM due to ATC staff/equipment en-route), APPR
title: No Travel Incomplete, Uncontrollable (arrival delay code 82, ATFM due to ATC staff/equipment en-route), APPR
description:
Two-leg journey. Leg 1 operated on time. Leg 2 was delayed more than 3 hours by delay code 83. In this scenario, ATC applied an arrival flow restriction at YVR because of reduced runway capacity (uncontrollable, NAS). The customer was stranded at the connection (YYZ), chose not to continue, and didn't return to YUL. Checks that No Travel Incomplete plus an uncontrollable arrival delay code returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a pro-rated or full refund of the unused portion.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC054: one adult passenger, two AC domestic legs YUL?YYZ?YVR, May 29, 2026. Leg 1 AC 466 YUL?YYZ: operated, on time, no delay codes. Leg 2 AC 467 YYZ?YVR: scheduled 11:00 ? 13:05 (local). Actual departure 14:40 (220 min late). Actual arrival 16:50 (225 min late). Status: DELAYED (operated). Cancellation code: NONE. First arrival delay code 83 (AE). First departure delay code 83 (AE). Customer action: stranded at YYZ (midpoint). Didn't board Leg 2, so the Leg 2 coupon wasn't flown. Didn't return to YUL. Didn't reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete. No rebooking accepted.
